# SQL feature support

<!-- Generated by tools/restprobe. Do not edit; run `just docs` to regenerate. -->

This page lists the statements and clauses BigQuery accepts and whether the emulator runs them.
DDL options are listed in [options.md](options.md), built-in functions in
[functions.md](functions.md), and behavior these tables cannot show in
[compatibility.md](compatibility.md).

`tools/restprobe` runs each query in `tools/sql_features.txt` with jobs.query against the fixture
tables `t (id INT64, name STRING, tags ARRAY<STRING>, s STRUCT<a INT64, b STRING>)` and
`u (id INT64, v INT64)`. A probe checks only that a query translates and runs on DuckDB, not that
it returns what BigQuery would. The notes of a Partial feature list the forms the emulator
rejected.

- **Supported**: every query runs.
- **Partial**: some queries run, and the emulator rejects the others as unsupported.
- **Unsupported**: the emulator rejects every query as unsupported.
- **Broken**: a query translates but fails on DuckDB, which is a bug.

| Section | Supported | Partial | Unsupported |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Graphs](#graphs) | 0 | 4 | 0 |
| [Queries](#queries) | 34 | 2 | 0 |
| [DML](#dml) | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| [DDL](#ddl) | 23 | 10 | 0 |
| [Collation](#collation) | 14 | 0 | 1 |
| [Multi-statement queries](#multi-statement-queries) | 11 | 2 | 0 |
| [INFORMATION_SCHEMA](#information_schema) | 11 | 0 | 0 |

## Graphs

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH` | Partial | [Graph limits](compatibility.md#graphs). Unsupported: property graph creation modes or options. |
| `DROP PROPERTY GRAPH` | Partial | Unsupported: this DROP PROPERTY GRAPH form. |
| `GRAPH_TABLE` | Partial | [Graph limits](compatibility.md#graphs). Unsupported: graph costs or hints. |
| GQL queries | Partial | [Graph limits](compatibility.md#graphs). Unsupported: graph costs or hints. |

| `CREATE FUNCTION` | Partial | See [User-defined functions](compatibility.md#user-defined-functions). Unsupported: JavaScript UDF arguments of type DATE; Python UDF argument types other than BOOL, INT64, FLOAT64, STRING or BYTES; function IFERROR; persistent non-SQL UDFs; volatile SQL UDF arguments with subquery bodies. |
| `DROP FUNCTION` | Supported |  |

| `DROP PROCEDURE` | Partial | See [Stored procedures](compatibility.md#stored-procedures). Unsupported: persistent routine name missing without a dataset. |
